gameGuides.title: ARC Raiders: Raid Prep and Extraction

items.title: Loadout philosophy
items.notes: Bring gear you can afford to lose. Save the good weapons for duo runs with a plan.

items.title: Solo vs. squad
items.notes: Solo: play quiet, loot the edges of the map. Squad: hit high-value zones early before other teams rotate in.

items.title: Medium shield + 3 bandages
items.notes: Minimum before dropping in.

items.title: Spare ammo stack
items.notes: Ran dry twice last week. Always carry one extra.

items.title: Zipline or grapple tool
items.notes: Makes escaping ARC patrols much easier.

items.title: Free slots for loot
items.notes: Leave at least 4 empty slots for blueprints and rare parts.

items.title: Opening 5 minutes
items.notes: Land near the outskirts, clear small ARC drones, grab crafting materials.

items.title: Mid-raid
items.notes: Check the two supply stations on the way to the extraction point. Avoid open fields when the big ARC units patrol.

items.title: Extraction
items.notes: Call extraction early and hold a corner. Most deaths happen in the last 60 seconds.

mediaItems.title: I’m the Max-Level Newbie
mediaItems.synopsis:
Kang Jin-Hyeok, a gaming streamer, and content creator is the only person who has cleared the game, [Tower of Trials]. However, as the game’s popularity declines, it becomes increasingly difficult for him to continue making a living as a content creator. Jinhyeok prepares to end his 11-year-long relationship with the game and say goodbye to his humble group of subscribers. But on that very day, the Tower of Trials appears in reality with a message saying that humanity will perish unless all players clear each floor within 90 days. Jin-Hyeok, who knows the game better than anyone, decides to use his knowledge to his advantage and dominate the tower. It’s time to show everyone what a hardcore gamer can do!



(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

mediaItems.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End
mediaItems.synopsis:
The adventure is over but life goes on for an elf mage just beginning to learn what living is all about. Elf mage Frieren and her courageous fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. But Frieren will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to understand what life means to the people around her? Decades after their victory, the funeral of one her friends confronts Frieren with her own near immortality. mediaItems.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
mediaItems.synopsis:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district.



One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature.



Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation."



To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again.



From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.



(Source: Crunchyroll News)
